home.intro: Journey through Middle-earth, choose the hero who will carry your story, and decide what the Ring will cost.
home.campaignDescription: Follow the Ring-bearer, reclaim the Lonely Mountain, or enter the age when the Rings were forged.
home.heroDescription: Every hero follows a personal route with their own abilities, relics and combat symbols.
home.mechanicsTitle: Three ways to face a trial
home.mechanicsDescription: Your choices open different routes through encounters. Prepare for the battles you can’t avoid.
home.mapDescription: Track your current chapter on the map. Events unlock new locations as you travel through a world shaped by its age.
home.jackpotDescription: Match three of a hero’s signature symbol in a row on an active line to trigger a special scene and a unique combat effect.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.body: Equip two relics to change your strengths. Some artifacts can open a new way through an encounter.

progress.title: Hero progression
progress.body: Level up by clearing chapters, find optional trials at camp and collect rewards along the way.

local.title: Browser saves
local.body: Progress saves automatically in this browser. Export a backup from Settings to carry it to another device.

cost.question: Does it cost anything to play?
cost.answer: The game is free. Coins are virtual and earned through story events.

offline.question: Where is my progress saved?
offline.answer: Your progress is stored on this device in your browser’s IndexedDB. You can export a backup and import it later.

switch.question: Can I change heroes mid-story?
switch.answer: Yes. Every hero keeps their exact place in the story, including any unfinished battle, cards or dice trial.

war.name: War of the Ring
war.description: Carry the Ring to the fire or gather allies for the last defense of Gondor.

hobbit.name: The Hobbit
hobbit.description: Join the company on the road to Erebor, where a dragon guards the halls of a lost kingdom.

power.name: The Rings of Power
power.description: Build alliances, uncover the cost of ringcraft, or seize the forge yourself.

rules.battle: Match symbols across five lines to deal damage, shield or heal. Spend Focus to hold reels or use your hero’s ability.
rules.blackjack: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Aces count as 1 or 11. The dealer draws to 17.
rules.dice: Roll five dice against an opponent. The higher total after three rounds wins. Ties go to extra rounds.
rules.coin: Call each toss. A correct call earns you a point; the first to two wins.

game.invalidSave: This save is damaged or uses an unsupported version.
game.storageError: The browser could not access this save.
game.chooseCampaignHelp: Begin a new chronicle or return to a hero you’ve played.

story.checkpointText: Your place in the chapter is saved. If you fall in battle, you can try again from here.
story.choiceText: Choose how to get through this encounter. Your approach changes the options you have later.
story.bossText: A powerful foe bars the way. Its attacks change as its health falls.
story.rewardText: Collect the spoils of this chapter before continuing.
story.campText: Rest to restore your health and prepare for the road. The next stop is marked on your map.
story.endText: The chronicle is complete. Your artifacts and discoveries are recorded in your journal.
story.accord: Word of the agreement has reached the guides on this road.
story.forged: The seals from the forge are spreading your command to nearby strongholds.
story.restedCamp: The company has rested. Check your gear or speak with your companions before setting out.

choiceEffect.battle: Fight a battle on the reels. Defeat returns you to the checkpoint.
choiceEffect.blackjack: Play for information. A loss reduces the coin reward; the journey continues.
choiceEffect.dice: Play a three-round duel. A loss reduces the coin reward; the journey continues.
choiceEffect.negotiate: Use your standing to open the way without a contest.
choiceEffect.useArtifact: Use the equipped Forge Ember to open the way.
choiceEffect.corrupt: Use your influence to forge a pact and earn the Ring of Dominion.
choiceEffect.coin: A quick contest. A loss reduces the coin reward, and the road remains open.

choice.corrupt: Seal the pact with a ring

battle.rerollHelp: Spin again without an enemy counterattack. Costs 3 Focus and restores none.

trials.mainwin: The challenge is won. Collect your reward and continue.
trials.mainloss: You can continue the journey with a smaller coin reward.
trials.sideloss: The camp trial ends here. Your main journey can continue.
trials.sidedraw: The trial ends in a draw. Return to camp.

camp.war: The night watch has a seal for anyone who can outplay the keeper before dawn.
camp.hobbit: The company keeps its supplies in a chest locked by a set of carved dice.
camp.power: The watch captain uses five carved stones to test anyone seeking the forge’s seal.

settings.local: All hero progress is saved in this browser. Export a copy to keep a backup.
settings.confirmReset: Reset every hero, item and achievement in this browser?
settings.confirmImport: Replace the progress in this browser with the selected save?

waystone.name: Waystone
waystone.description: A marked river stone, kept by travelers for protection.

ember.name: Forge Ember
ember.description: A coal from the old forges. Its glow opens some sealed passages.

seal.name: Watch Seal
seal.description: A token from the camp watch that grants extra starting Focus.

crown.name: Chronicle Crown
crown.description: A relic awarded to a hero who completes their chronicle.

dominion.name: Ring of Dominion
dominion.description: A ring forged to bind a pact. It strengthens dark magic and starting Focus.

westStar.name: Star of the West
westStar.description: A ranger’s pin awarded to a traveler who helps keep the crossing open.

mountainKey.name: Mountain Key
mountainKey.description: A dwarven key with a grip worn smooth by generations of watchkeepers.

brightSeal.name: Bright Forge Seal
brightSeal.description: An unbound seal hammered from the first batch of refined mithril.

landmarks.shire: Lanterns shine over closed round doors. A party has crossed the old bridge before dawn, leaving a trail in the wet grass.
landmarks.bree: The innkeeper has set aside a table by the hearth. A courier with a torn cloak is waiting there.
landmarks.weathertop: Rain has washed the old watchtower clean. The ashes in the doorway are still warm.
landmarks.rivendell: Rivers meet below the terraces. The council has left a seat empty for the last traveler to arrive.
landmarks.moria: A collapsed stair descends into the abandoned mines. The noise beneath it sounds like drums.
landmarks.lorien: Silver leaves fall onto a rope bridge. On the other side a sentinel waits with a folded map.
landmarks.amon: From the ruined seat you can see the river split. A broken oar drifts toward the eastern bank.
landmarks.rohan: The riders’ road winds through empty farms. A watch fire on the ridge cuts through the rain.
landmarks.helm: Water runs beneath the wall. The defenders are closing the sluice before the first horns sound.
landmarks.fangorn: The trees crowd the road. Someone has wedged a fresh branch under a stone like a signpost.
landmarks.minas: The white city has rung its bells. The wounded and the last reserve are climbing the same narrow street.
landmarks.marshes: Pale lights move just below the water. A string of reeds marks the only firm ground.
landmarks.ithilien: The scent of crushed herbs hides the smoke of a ranger camp. Three stones on the path signal danger.
landmarks.cirith: The stairs disappear into webbing. The lower tower has exchanged its watch ahead of schedule.
landmarks.mordor: Ash covers the road to the fortress. Fresh tracks veer away from the main gate.
landmarks.doom: The path narrows above a river of lava. An iron stair is the last way to the chamber.
landmarks.gate: Beyond the teeth of the gate, a line of spears turns toward the road.
landmarks.trollshaws: The fire smells of singed wool. A bag of stolen supplies lies near the sleeping trolls.
landmarks.goblins: Wooden bridges connect the caverns. The guards have pulled up the ladder nearest the exit.
landmarks.cave: Drops fall from the roof into a black lake. An unseen voice asks what the traveler carries.
landmarks.mirkwood: The path splits where the webs begin. From the branches comes the sound of tightening silk.
landmarks.lake: The wharf rises on blackened pilings. A boatman offers a passage before the wind turns.
landmarks.erebor: The sealed gate casts a shadow across the valley. From a crack in the rock comes the smell of hot metal.
landmarks.five: Separate banners rise over the same field. A horn from the north interrupts the parley.
landmarks.numenor: Bronze doors look out over a crowded harbor. A captain waits with an unsigned sailing charter.
landmarks.eregion: Hammer strokes ring from the terrace. A courier has left a wax tablet beside the molds.
landmarks.lindon: Golden trees shelter the council stones. Guests lay their letters beside a bowl of still water.
landmarks.khazad: Lanterns light an unbroken stair down to the workshops. Music rises from the market in the lower halls.
landmarks.rhun: Stars appear above white dunes. A caravan has buried its water chest beside a standing stone.
landmarks.southlands: Families are bringing their grain to the watchtower. An emissary has arrived ahead of the smoke.

frodo.name: Frodo
frodo.description: A quiet Ring-bearer who can vanish under pressure and endure the road to Mordor.
frodo.opening: The riders will look for me at home. I’ll put the lane behind me before breakfast and see who follows.
frodo.mission: I can feel the Ring pull when the road turns east. We need a guide who knows which paths the watchers can see.
frodo.finale: The fire is close enough to hear. If I can get past the last watcher, I can let the Ring go.
frodo.cinematic: The Ring disappears under a cloak. A blade flashes through the dark.
frodo.ending: The last watcher falls. Frodo opens his hand above the fire, and the weight he carried all the way from the Shire is gone.

aragorn.name: Aragorn
aragorn.description: A ranger who turns scattered travelers into an army and breaks enemy defenses.
aragorn.opening: The courier from the south carries a broken seal. Find who opened it before the word reaches Gondor.
aragorn.mission: Keep the crossings open. Every household we guide south gives the defenders someone to fight for.
aragorn.finale: When we raise the banner here, the Eye will turn toward us. That buys the Ring-bearer time.
aragorn.cinematic: Andúril cuts through the enemy line, and the guard advances under its light.
aragorn.ending: The banner holds at the gate until the Eye goes dark. Riders leave for Gondor with the names of those who stood beside it.

gandalf.name: Gandalf
gandalf.description: A wandering wizard who uses runes, flame and a sharp eye for ancient magic.
gandalf.opening: There is a mark beneath the ash in the old hearth. The Ring has stirred something that remembers its maker.
gandalf.mission: A hidden fire runs under these roads. I’ll hold the way open while the company carries its light farther.
gandalf.finale: The beacons have spoken. I can hold back the shadow at the gate while the last of our strength comes up the road.
gandalf.cinematic: Light pours from the staff and scorches the shadows clinging to the enemy.
gandalf.ending: The dark gives way. Gandalf lights the beacon above the road so that the company can find the way back.

legolas.name: Legolas
legolas.description: A woodland archer who spots a path others miss and looses a devastating volley.
legolas.opening: The wind carries a note I know from home. Something unfamiliar has entered the woods, and it moves with the company.
legolas.mission: Follow the scuffed branches. I can cover the bridge if the others drive our pursuers into the open.
legolas.finale: I saved the last arrows for the watchers above the gate. Once they look down, the path is ours.
legolas.cinematic: Three arrows leave the bow before the first strikes its mark.
legolas.ending: The towers fall silent. Legolas walks the cleared path with his bow lowered and marks a safe crossing for those who follow.

gimli.name: Gimli
gimli.description: A guardian with a heavy axe and a habit of holding the narrowest passage.
gimli.opening: There is still a chair waiting for me in the old halls. I carry tools as well as an axe. We may need both.
gimli.mission: Tell me where the builders laid their strongest stone. Put me there, and the line will hold.
gimli.finale: We’ll stand where the ground narrows. They’ll have to pass my axe before they reach the others.
gimli.cinematic: The axe bites deep and a stone shield rises around the company.
gimli.ending: The axe holds the narrow ground. Gimli carves the names of the company into a stone where the road opens again.

sam.name: Sam
sam.description: A stubborn gardener whose supplies and loyalty keep the company on its feet.
sam.quest: A light for the way back
sam.opening: The pack’s ready. I tucked in a handful of seeds for the walk home.
sam.mission: I’ll carry the water and keep watch at the crossing. Let the others sleep while there’s still time.
sam.finale: Give me the lantern. I can find the next step, and then I’ll find the one after that.
sam.cinematic: A lantern cuts the smoke, and the companions find strength to rise.
sam.ending: Sam keeps the lantern lit until the last step down. At home, there will be soil for the seeds he has carried so far.

bilbo.name: Bilbo
bilbo.description: An unlikely burglar who bargains with riddles and looks for a way through danger.
bilbo.opening: They left me a contract and took the good cakes. I suppose I’d better catch up before they eat the provisions as well.
bilbo.mission: A riddle can buy more time than a sword. I’ll see what I can learn about the road through the mountain.
bilbo.finale: If I can get the banners to wait a little longer, we might have a chance to turn them toward the same enemy.
bilbo.cinematic: A lucky charm tumbles from a pocket. By the time it lands, Bilbo is behind the enemy.
bilbo.ending: The banners turn together at last. Bilbo folds his old contract and goes looking for somewhere to put the kettle on.

thorin.name: Thorin
thorin.description: The heir of Erebor fights for his halls with Orcrist and the power of the Arkenstone.
thorin.opening: The key has waited longer than any of us. Stay close. I won’t lose another company before we reach our halls.
thorin.mission: Follow the signs my grandfather left in the stone. Every mile puts the dragon closer to the reach of Orcrist.
thorin.finale: The halls are within reach. If the dragon’s last fire takes the field, shield the company and follow me.
thorin.cinematic: The Arkenstone lights a golden ward as Orcrist comes down.
thorin.ending: The gate to Erebor opens. Thorin carries the key inside and sets it on the stone table for the people returning home.

balin.name: Balin
balin.description: A scholar and steady negotiator who records promises and keeps the company together.
balin.opening: I’ve written the names of everyone we left behind. By the time we get to Erebor, this book will name our allies as well.
balin.mission: Keep a record of the food, ferries and beds offered to us. A kingdom should remember what it owes.
balin.finale: There’s one blank page left. Let’s give the living something to sign when the field is quiet.
balin.cinematic: The book opens to a forgotten oath and the company closes ranks.
balin.ending: The last page records the promise made on the field. Balin leaves room beneath it for the names of witnesses.

kili.name: Kili
kili.description: A young marksman who hunts from cover and punishes exposed targets.
kili.opening: A track leads from the thicket to the ridge. I can take the high path and warn the company without being seen.
kili.mission: I’ve seen how the spiders mark their trails. Cut the low webs first so the others have room to run.
kili.finale: The brood followed us out of the forest. I’ll draw the mother away from the banners and settle this here.
kili.cinematic: The arrow finds a gap as the target turns toward the fire.
kili.ending: The last web falls slack. The road out of the forest stays open while the wounded are carried to shelter.

fili.name: Fili
fili.description: A resourceful scout who works locks, revives old tools and secures escape routes.
fili.opening: I’ve got a knife for rope and a bent nail for locks. Watch the road while I find the first door.
fili.mission: I’ll leave a mark on any door that can be opened from both sides. Remember it if we get separated.
fili.finale: The tunnel gate is clear. I’ll keep the passage open until the last of the wounded gets through.
fili.cinematic: A second dagger appears just as the first one pins the guard’s blade.
fili.ending: The last stretcher passes through the tunnel. Fili leaves his mark on the door before he closes it behind him.

dwalin.name: Dwalin
dwalin.description: A veteran guard whose hammer breaks enemy lines and covers a retreat.
dwalin.opening: The others have the lead. If anything comes out of the thicket behind us, I’ll hear it first.
dwalin.mission: Send the carts onward. I’ll keep the rear path clear until they find solid ground.
dwalin.finale: Give the wounded my place behind the shield wall. I’ll meet their chief on the far side of it.
dwalin.cinematic: The hammer strikes shields and sends the front rank staggering.
dwalin.ending: When the chief falls, the carts are already safe. Dwalin puts down his hammer and takes a turn at the cookfire.

sauron.name: Sauron
sauron.description: A master of deception who trades favors for influence and binds pacts with dark magic.
sauron.opening: The watch wants protection before harvest. I can grant it and make their need the first link in a chain.
sauron.mission: Offer the smiths a solution to their shortage. When they accept, stamp the agreement with the ring I forged.
sauron.finale: The wardens are the last to refuse my seal. Once the forge is mine, every bargain will carry the same command.
sauron.cinematic: The One Ring rises in his hand. Dark fire catches around the foe and leaves a curse.
sauron.ending: The wardens surrender their forge. The first messenger leaves wearing the seal, and the watch opens every gate before him.

galadriel.name: Galadriel
galadriel.description: An elven commander who tracks a hidden enemy and shields allies with light.
galadriel.opening: The same mark appears on three letters from the south. Give me a ship, and I’ll find who pressed the seal.
galadriel.mission: Ask how many promised reinforcements arrived. Whoever is offering help is leaving the villages defenseless.
galadriel.finale: The forge has the same mark. I’ll put its wardens in the light and get the names of those behind it.
galadriel.cinematic: A silver light falls across the field and settles into a shield.
galadriel.ending: The stolen seals are recovered. Galadriel sends a warning to the villages before the next company sets sail.

elrond.name: Elrond
elrond.description: A diplomat whose treaties protect allies and whose magic punishes broken oaths.
elrond.opening: The council wants mithril. I want a treaty each side can read aloud without shame.
elrond.mission: Record the trade terms in both languages. An agreement is worth little if only one side has the words.
elrond.finale: The pact has brought us here together. Hold the passage while we get the envoys back to safety.
elrond.cinematic: The treaty seal lifts into the air as allies close the gaps in the line.
elrond.ending: The envoys are safe. Elrond returns both copies of the pact and asks the signatories to read them together.

celebrimbor.name: Celebrimbor
celebrimbor.description: A master smith whose forge magic strengthens attacks and reshapes the battlefield.
celebrimbor.opening: One of the sketches has an extra channel drawn inside the band. I’ll follow the metal back to the mine before I use it.
celebrimbor.mission: The alloy accepts an imprint during cooling. Keep the test ring separate until I find whose mark it took.
celebrimbor.finale: Break the stolen molds and let the metal run back into the furnace. I’ll deal with the guard.
celebrimbor.cinematic: A smith’s sigil blooms white-hot as the forge sends a wave across the chamber.
celebrimbor.ending: The molds break and the stolen alloy runs into the furnace. Celebrimbor takes the surviving sketch back to Eregion.

durin.name: Durin IV
durin.description: A prince of Khazad-dûm who protects his miners and channels mithril into shields.
durin.opening: The lower hall is still singing at this hour. That makes it hard to hear the new crack by the mithril vein.
durin.mission: Bring a sample to the elven smiths, and make them show us where every ingot goes. Our miners are taking the risk.
durin.finale: The missing ingots are in that forge. I’ll lead my crew home as soon as the wardens lay down their weapons.
durin.cinematic: Mithril threads surge through the stone and harden into a shield.
durin.ending: The miners carry the last ingot out of the forge. In Khazad-dûm, the lower halls welcome every one of them home.

istar.name: The Istar
istar.description: A wandering stranger who wakes forgotten magic by following patterns in the stars.
istar.opening: I know the stars above these dunes. I couldn’t tell you how. Someone in the caravan can teach me their names.
istar.mission: The missing stars leave a direction. Follow it to the source of the ash and keep the lantern lit.
istar.finale: The ash rises from the door. I can use the pattern on my staff to guide the caravan through it.
istar.cinematic: A constellation appears in the ash and sheds a clear light across the road.
istar.ending: The caravan crosses under a clear sky. The stranger names the first star he remembers and walks west.

trollTracks.title: Missing provisions
trollTracks.text: Two bags are missing from the mule. See how the drag marks leave the track? Whoever took them is carrying them toward that smoke.

trollFire.title: The trolls’ fire
trollFire.text: Three trolls, all arguing over the same pot. If I can keep them talking until sunrise, they may forget there’s anyone else in these woods.

trollDawn.title: First light
trollDawn.text: Keep back from the clearing. The first light has turned the trolls to stone, and their footprints lead to a cave under that ridge.

trollCache.title: Under the ridge
trollCache.text: Here are the company’s provisions. Leave the heavy chests. Take what we can carry, and wrap those blades until someone can read the marks.

trollSpoils.title: Spoils of the cave
trollSpoils.text: The company recovers its provisions and takes a share of the trolls’ abandoned hoard.

trollCamp.title: By the fire
trollCamp.text: The packs are dry again. Sit a while. I have five dice and a stump wide enough for a game.

elrondWelcome.title: A welcome in the valley
elrondWelcome.text: The bridges are watched, and there are beds for your company. You may rest before you decide what to tell me of your road.

thorinReserve.title: Thorin’s reserve
thorinReserve.text: I am grateful for the shelter. The map is another matter. It belonged to my grandfather, and I know too little of our host to unfold it lightly.

balinCounsel.title: Balin’s counsel
balinCounsel.text: Tell him what we need to find, Thorin. He can read the marks without being told what you mean to do with the mountain.

elrondRunes.title: Moon-letters
elrondRunes.text: Bring the parchment where the moon can reach it. The hidden writing tells of a thrush, the last light of Durin’s Day, and a place where it will reveal the keyhole.

mountainPass.title: The mountain road
mountainPass.text: We cross into the Misty Mountains when the company is rested. I’ll ask the valley’s scouts which paths still hold after the rain.

rivendellGift.title: A gift from the hearth
rivendellGift.text: The valley’s smiths send a Forge Ember with the company. Take it before leaving for the mountain passes.

rivendellRest.title: Before departure
rivendellRest.text: Eat and sleep while the roads are quiet. I’ve asked my scouts to bring word of the pass before you set out.

trollHiddenDawn.title: Dawn beyond the rocks
trollHiddenDawn.text: The Waystone led you around their fire. Now that the sun has turned the trolls to stone, we can search the cave.

trollStalledDawn.title: The last argument
trollStalledDawn.text: Bilbo kept them arguing until sunrise. Look under the ledge before we leave. They must have hidden their plunder nearby.

goblinBridges.title: The bridges below
goblinBridges.text: The captain holds the ladder out of these caverns. If he won’t let us pass, we can win a guide at the guard post or take the ladder ourselves.

balinBelow.title: A way through
balinBelow.text: You listened to me in Rivendell. Listen now. We need a way out, and the captain’s guards might wager the way to the ladder.

goblinExit.title: Daylight at the far ledge
goblinExit.text: The company crosses the last bridge. In the light above the ladder, Thorin checks the Mountain Key.

countCompany.title: Names at the ledge
countCompany.text: Give me a name for every pack. Then we’ll move before the guards miss their ladder.

spiderTrail.title: Silk across the path
spiderTrail.text: The web runs across every trail, and the broodmother is between us and the river. Keep Bilbo close. We’ll cut through together.

spiderEscape.title: The broken web
spiderEscape.text: The broodmother falls. The company frees the trapped packs and cuts a path toward the river.

mirkwoodCamp.title: The sound of water
mirkwoodCamp.text: I can hear the river again. The current should carry us to the lake before the forest closes in.

lakeLanding.title: The trader’s terms
lakeLanding.text: The trader knows which boat can take us to the far shore. Win a game with him or call in a favour. Either way, we need passage before dawn.

lakeWatch.title: Before the crossing
lakeWatch.text: Take what we can carry. The Mountain is close, and the people here have already given more than I had any right to ask.

mountainGate.title: At the Mountain
mountainGate.text: The stone is warm. Smaug is still inside. Once the company finds the way in, I’ll lead the fight.

mountainKeyReady.title: The key turns
mountainKeyReady.text: The moon-letters brought us to this door, and the key from the caverns fits. Stay close. Smaug is still inside.

dragonFallen.title: After the dragon
dragonFallen.text: Smaug has fallen. The company can enter the halls and count what the dragon left behind.

ereborBanners.title: Banners in the valley
ereborBanners.text: There are people from the lake at the gates. Hear them before you count another chest. And keep a watch to the north.

azogApproach.title: The northern horn
azogApproach.text: Azog’s host is coming down from the north. Open the gates for the wounded and send word to the banners in the valley.

afterSmaug.title: The war at the gate
afterSmaug.text: Smaug is dead, and a new horn sounds from the north. Azog is coming. Send word to the others. We hold the gate together.

azogFallen.title: The field falls quiet
azogFallen.text: Azog has fallen. The company calls the wounded back from the field and opens the Mountain’s gates.

thorinPeace.title: The restored hall
thorinPeace.text: Thorin receives the survivors in the hall. The people of Lake-town have a place at his table and a share for rebuilding their homes.

battle.name: Face the trolls
battle.effect: Fight for the missing supplies. A defeat returns you to this checkpoint.

distract.name: Distract the trolls
distract.effect: Give Bilbo time to keep them talking until dawn. Earn reputation without a fight.

sneak.name: Slip past the fire
sneak.effect: Follow the trail with the Waystone equipped to find a hidden cache.

showMap.name: Show Elrond the map
showMap.effect: Trust Elrond with Thrór’s map and go straight to the reading.

askBalin.name: Speak to Balin first
askBalin.effect: Ask Balin how to approach Elrond and unlock an extra conversation.

blackjack.name: Play the quay trader
blackjack.effect: Play a hand for supplies and information. Losing costs part of the coin reward; the road stays open.

negotiate.name: Ask the traders for passage
negotiate.effect: Use your reputation to make an agreement without playing cards.

dice.name: Play dice with the trader
dice.effect: A loss reduces the coin reward. The road remains open.

coin.name: Call the trader’s coin
coin.effect: A quick contest. A loss reduces the coin reward, and the road remains open.

chronicle.campDice: Balin has cleared a stump by the fire. Play five dice against him while the others sleep.

landmarks.trollshaws: A trail of missing provisions leads into the woods. Smoke rises from a clearing off the road.
landmarks.rivendell: Elrond offers the company shelter in the valley. There is time to study Thrór’s map before crossing the Misty Mountains.
landmarks.lake: The company looks for supplies and information among the markets on the lake.

coin.call: Choose a side to toss the coin.
coin.tossing: The coin is in the air…

challenge.campStakes: You earn the camp prize if you win. The road stays open after a loss.
challenge.campGame: The company makes room for a friendly challenge.

rules.battle: Spin the reels, match symbols and use your hero’s abilities.
rules.blackjack: Beat the dealer’s hand without going over 21.
rules.dice: Roll five dice per round. The higher total after three rounds wins.
rules.coin: Call each toss. A correct call earns you a point; the first to two wins.
